record.field: # Upon sending the request to Nominatim, we specify a user agent to identify the source of the request. This is a good practice to avoid being blocked by Nominatim. # By default, we use this format "odoo-{COMPANY_NAME}-geocoder/1.0 ({BASE_URL})" # If you would like to change the identifier, you can set it via context key "cron_user_agent_geocoder", for example "odoo-mycompany-geocoder/1.0 (https://mycompany.com)" model.with_context(from_cron=True,cron_user_agent_geocoder=False).action_cron_geolocalize_using_nominatim()
